title: Intelligence Brief
headline: Google's Android team publishes an official Agent Skills repository
subtitle: Google's Android team publishes an official Agent, MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search leads GitHub Trending, cursor/plugins reappears on GitHub Trending after

heroStat.label: applications, first interviews, and signed contracts the creator of today's #1 GitHub Trending repo reports from his own Claude Code job-search pipeline

insights.text: Google's Android team publishes an official Agent Skills repository (android/skills), deliberately scoped to 'use cases and workflows where evaluations show LLMs underperform' rather than well-covered basics, installed via a dedicated Android CLI following the open agentskills.io SKILL.md standard.
insights.source: GitHub Trending scrape, 2026-10-19T05:19:07Z; repository README, deep-read

insights.text: MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search leads GitHub Trending (2,232 stars today; 53,971 total). It is a job-application pipeline built entirely on Claude Code, billed through a Pro/Max/Team subscription or API credits, with no bundled model. The creator's own linked account: 69 tailored applications, 20 first interviews, 1 signed contract.
insights.source: GitHub Trending scrape, 2026-10-19T05:19:07Z; repository README, deep-read

insights.text: cursor/plugins reappears on GitHub Trending (#4) after yesterday's absence, confirming that absence was a capture-depth artifact. affaan-m/ECC, which had held its own Trending slot for three straight days, is itself absent today despite a direct API pull showing continued (if marginal) growth.
insights.source: GitHub Trending scrape, 2026-10-19T05:19:07Z; GitHub API, fetched directly

insights.text: A new arXiv paper, 'Hybrid Reasoning Agents,' reports a 10.4% performance gain across 11 benchmarks alongside 35.5-54.7% token reduction and 2.7-3.7x cost savings, by letting a model switch between latent-space and text-based reasoning within one generation stream. All figures are author-reported, not independently replicated.
insights.source: Hacker News #2 (297 pts); arXiv 2610.18861, read directly

insights.text: Anthropic commits 5% of its shares to a new, wholly-owned 'Public Benefit Fund,' growable by about 2% more per 50% rise in company value, ahead of a planned November IPO.
insights.source: TechCrunch and Anthropic's own announcement, deep-read via search

insights.text: Claude by Anthropic is absent from the captured Google Play top 30 for a third consecutive day, extending the reversal first logged 2026-10-17 and approaching this page's own week-long bar for confirming a genuine, sustained drop.

Music Player & MP3 - DDMusic holds #3 in today's Play Store capture, repeating a suffix-keyword-stacking ASO pattern first logged in September: an invented compound brand wrapped inside a generic category phrase.

morluto/rea is absent from GitHub Trending for a third straight capture, but a direct API pull shows continued growth (325,462 stars, up from 293,860 two days earlier) at a decelerating rate consistent with the page's standing pattern.
